news_articles.title: Schneider Electric next gen motor management solution TeSys Tera now in West Africa
news_articles.snippet: Schneider Electric, a global energy technology leader, has announced the availability of its TeSys Tera motor management solution across the West African market.

news_articles.title: Schneider Electric to power Iraq's first commercial Tier III Data Center.
news_articles.snippet: Schneider Electric, a global energy technology leader, announces a strategic collaboration with T964, a leading technology and connectivity investment group, to become the technology partner responsible for the power and cooling infrastructure of the T964 Data Center, Iraq's first, largest, and most advanced commercial Tier III data center.

news_articles.title: Schneider Electric helps Northumbria NHS Trust achieve 100% uptime with EcoStruxure.
news_articles.snippet: Schneider Electric, an energy technology company, has completed an infrastructure modernisation project for the Northumbria Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust intended to support availability for systems used in patient care.

news_articles.title: New SI programme strengthens Schneider Electric's partner ecosystem across Africa
news_articles.snippet: Schneider Electric, a global energy technology leader, will soon officially launch its new System Integrator (SI) Programme - SI Energise 2.0 - which will mark a major change in how the company partners with industrial automation specialists across Southern, East and West Africa.

news_articles.title: NDPHC begins Gbarain Power Plant revival, targets 225MW boost.
news_articles.snippet: The Niger Delta Power Holding Company (NDPHC) has officially handed over the rehabilitation of its Gbarain Power Plant to a joint venture comprising TILT Energy Limited and Schneider Electric for the replacement of the plant's burnt power control module (PCM).
